945: 
946:     y_est = util.index_labels(y_est)[0]
947: 
948:     # Mutual information
949:     mutual_info = _mutual_info_score(y_ref, y_est)
950: 
951:     # Adjusted mutual information
952:     adj_mutual_info = _adjusted_mutual_info_score(y_ref, y_est)
953: 
954:     # Normalized mutual information
955:     norm_mutual_info = _normalized_mutual_info_score(y_ref, y_est)
956: 
957:     return mutual_info, adj_mutual_info, norm_mutual_info
958: 
959: 
960: def nce(
961:     reference_intervals,
962:     reference_labels,
963:     estimated_intervals,
964:     estimated_labels,
965:     frame_size=0.1,
966:     beta=1.0,
967:     marginal=False,
968: ):
969:     """Frame-clustering segmentation: normalized conditional entropy
970: 
971:     Computes cross-entropy of cluster assignment, normalized by the
972:     max-entropy.
973: 
974:     Examples
975:     --------
976:     >>> (ref_intervals,
977:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
978:     >>> (est_intervals,
979:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
980:     >>> # Trim or pad the estimate to match reference timing
981:     >>> (ref_intervals,
982:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(ref_intervals,
983:     ...                                               ref_labels,
984:     ...                                               t_min=0)
985:     >>> (est_intervals,
986:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
987:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, t_min=0, t_max=ref_intervals.max())
988:     >>> S_over, S_under, S_F = mir_eval.structure.nce(ref_intervals,
989:     ...                                               ref_labels,
990:     ...                                               est_intervals,
991:     ...                                               est_labels)
992: 
993:     Parameters
994:     ----------
995:     reference_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2)
996:         reference segment intervals, in the format returned by
997:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
998:     reference_labels : list, shape=(n,)
999:         reference segment labels, in the format returned by
1000:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1001:     estimated_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(m, 2)
1002:         estimated segment intervals, in the format returned by
1003:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1004:     estimated_labels : list, shape=(m,)
1005:         estimated segment labels, in the format returned by
1006:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1007:     frame_size : float > 0
1008:         length (in seconds) of frames for clustering
1009:         (Default value = 0.1)
1010:     beta : float > 0
1011:         beta for F-measure
1012:         (Default value = 1.0)
1013:     marginal : bool
1014:         If `False`, normalize conditional entropy by uniform entropy.
1015:         If `True`, normalize conditional entropy by the marginal entropy.
1016:         (Default value = False)
1017: 
1018:     Returns
1019:     -------
1020:     S_over
1021:         Over-clustering score:
1022: 
1023:         - For `marginal=False`, ``1 - H(y_est | y_ref) / log(|y_est|)``
1024: 
1025:         - For `marginal=True`, ``1 - H(y_est | y_ref) / H(y_est)``
1026: 
1027:         If `|y_est|==1`, then `S_over` will be 0.
1028:     S_under
1029:         Under-clustering score:
1030: 
1031:         - For `marginal=False`, ``1 - H(y_ref | y_est) / log(|y_ref|)``
1032: 
1033:         - For `marginal=True`, ``1 - H(y_ref | y_est) / H(y_ref)``
1034: 
1035:         If `|y_ref|==1`, then `S_under` will be 0.
1036:     S_F
1037:         F-measure for (S_over, S_under)
1038:     """
1039:     validate_structure(
1040:         reference_intervals, reference_labels, estimated_intervals, estimated_labels
1041:     )
1042: 
1043:     # Check for empty annotations.  Don't need to check labels because
1044:     # validate_structure makes sure they're the same size as intervals
1045:     if reference_intervals.size == 0 or estimated_intervals.size == 0:
1046:         return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
1047: 
1048:     # Generate the cluster labels
1049:     y_ref = util.intervals_to_samples(
1050:         reference_intervals, reference_labels, sample_size=frame_size
1051:     )[-1]
1052: 
1053:     y_ref = util.index_labels(y_ref)[0]
1054: 
1055:     # Map to index space
1056:     y_est = util.intervals_to_samples(
1057:         estimated_intervals, estimated_labels, sample_size=frame_size
1058:     )[-1]
1059: 
1060:     y_est = util.index_labels(y_est)[0]
1061: 
1062:     # Make the contingency table: shape = (n_ref, n_est)
1063:     contingency = _contingency_matrix(y_ref, y_est).astype(float)
1064: 
1065:     # Normalize by the number of frames
1066:     contingency = contingency / len(y_ref)
1067: 
1068:     # Compute the marginals
1069:     p_est = contingency.sum(axis=0)
1070:     p_ref = contingency.sum(axis=1)
1071: 
1072:     # H(true | prediction) = sum_j P[estimated = j] *
1073:     # sum_i P[true = i | estimated = j] log P[true = i | estimated = j]
1074:     # entropy sums over axis=0, which is true labels
1075: 
1076:     true_given_est = p_est.dot(scipy.stats.entropy(contingency, base=2))
1077:     pred_given_ref = p_ref.dot(scipy.stats.entropy(contingency.T, base=2))
1078: 
1079:     if marginal:
1080:         # Normalize conditional entropy by marginal entropy
1081:         z_ref = scipy.stats.entropy(p_ref, base=2)
1082:         z_est = scipy.stats.entropy(p_est, base=2)
1083:     else:
1084:         z_ref = np.log2(contingency.shape[0])
1085:         z_est = np.log2(contingency.shape[1])
1086: 
1087:     score_under = 0.0
1088:     if z_ref > 0:
1089:         score_under = 1.0 - true_given_est / z_ref
1090: 
1091:     score_over = 0.0
1092:     if z_est > 0:
1093:         score_over = 1.0 - pred_given_ref / z_est
1094: 
1095:     f_measure = util.f_measure(score_over, score_under, beta=beta)
1096: 
1097:     return score_over, score_under, f_measure
1098: 
1099: 
1100: def vmeasure(
